theses.title: LSK $0.50 Support Hold vs $0.571 Upwick Rejection: Breakout Confirmation Setup
theses.observation: LSK staged an 18.10% gain with a 45.45% intraday range, surging to $0.5710 before pulling back to consolidate near $0.5073.
theses.evidence: 1H candle data shows volume peaked at 13.31M LSK during the initial breakout candle to $0.4996, topped at $0.5710 on 7.52M volume, then settled into a lower-volume range near $0.5073 with 3.01M volume.
theses.non_obvious_interpretation: The sharp upwick to $0.5710 was not a outright collapse; it marked a liquidity sweep of overhead sell orders, transitioning LSK into an absorption phase around $0.50 rather than immediate panic distribution.
theses.mechanism_causal_chain: Aggressive market buys swept order book depth up to $0.5710 -> profit-taking and limit supply capped the candle -> volume dropped from 13.3M to 3.0M LSK while price stayed above $0.4946 -> indicates sellers are not aggressively driving price down.
theses.contradiction_or_risk: Decaying hourly volume could indicate buying interest has completely evaporated after the initial spike, leaving price vulnerable to a sharp pullback if $0.4812 breaks.
theses.confirmation_condition: A 1H candle closing above $0.5350 on expanding volume (>6M LSK) confirming buyer control. Invalidation occurs on a 1H candle closing below $0.4704.
theses.why_reader_cares: Prevents FOMO buying into extended upper wicks while providing clear, actionable risk levels around the $0.50 pivotal zone.

theses.title: Supply Lockup or Buyer Fatigue? Analyzing LSK's 77% Volume Decay
theses.observation: LSK's hourly trading volume dropped by over 77% from its peak expansion while price retained more than 70% of its surge.
theses.evidence: Peak volume reached 13.31M LSK on the move to $0.4996, but volume decayed across consecutive candles (9.03M -> 7.52M -> 4.75M -> 3.01M LSK) as price hovered between $0.4946 and $0.5352.
theses.non_obvious_interpretation: A steep volume contraction while price stays near local highs typically signals supply lockup (lack of eager sellers) rather than distribution.
theses.mechanism_causal_chain: Initial volume impulse cleared circulating float -> profit takers exited on the wick to $0.5710 -> low volume on the pullback shows holders are refusing to sell cheap -> minor influx of buy volume can move price higher easily.
theses.contradiction_or_risk: If low volume represents lack of market demand rather than supply scarcity, price will slowly bleed back toward the $0.4284 breakout level.
theses.confirmation_condition: Re-acceleration of hourly volume above 6.0M LSK accompanied by a price break above $0.5299. Invalidation on a loss of $0.4704.
theses.why_reader_cares: Teaches traders how to interpret volume decay during consolidation to avoid exiting winning setups prematurely.

theses.title: Upwick Liquidity Trap: The Contrarian Failure Case for LSK above $0.5350
theses.observation: LSK printed a long upper shadow reaching $0.5710 on heavy volume, followed by lower local highs on subsequent recovery attempts.
theses.evidence: The $0.5710 high on 7.52M LSK volume closed down at $0.4945; subsequent bounce candles managed only $0.5299 and $0.5352 on lower volume (5.12M and 3.01M LSK).
theses.non_obvious_interpretation: The rally to $0.5710 served as an exit liquidity event for trapped legacy holders, leaving aggressive late buyers holding high-cost positions.
theses.mechanism_causal_chain: Fast price expansion triggered breakout chasing -> passive sell orders absorbed momentum at $0.55–$0.5710 -> buyers exhausted cash reserves -> lower high structure ($0.5710 -> $0.5352) establishes overhead resistance.
theses.contradiction_or_risk: Holding above the $0.4812–$0.4946 support zone over multiple hourly closes negates the breakdown thesis and builds a base for retest.
theses.confirmation_condition: A 1H candle closing below $0.4812 confirming seller control toward $0.4284. Invalidation on a 1H candle close above $0.5352.
theses.why_reader_cares: Warns traders against buying lower highs after a major wick rejection, protecting capital from potential bull traps.

theses.title: LSK Post-Spike Range Compression: Volatility Reset at $0.4704–$0.5352
theses.observation: Following a 45.45% intraday range, LSK has entered a tight $0.065 horizontal range between $0.4704 and $0.5352.
theses.evidence: Recent 1H candles show price oscillating between a low of $0.4704/$0.4812 and a high of $0.5299/$0.5352, with price currently at $0.5073.
theses.non_obvious_interpretation: Intraday range compression after violent expansion is a necessary volatility reset that builds market structure before the next directional move.
theses.mechanism_causal_chain: Extreme volatility clears leverage on both sides -> price settles into a defined range -> open interest re-accumulates -> a breach of boundary levels triggers stop-loss sweeps and momentum continuation.
theses.contradiction_or_risk: Extended range chop can chop up accounts trying to trade inside the middle ($0.50) without taking a clear direction.
theses.confirmation_condition: A decisive 1H close outside $0.5352 (bullish expansion) or below $0.4704 (bearish breakdown).
theses.why_reader_cares: Keeps traders patient by defining the clear boundary conditions instead of overtrading inside noise.

theses.title: The Impulse-to-Decay Model: Evaluating LSK's Structural Health
theses.observation: LSK provides a clean market example for applying the Impulse-to-Decay mental model on small-cap breakouts.
theses.evidence: LSK ran +67% from $0.3412 to $0.5710 on cumulative 3-hour volume of ~29.8M LSK, followed by a shallow 38% price retracement to $0.4704 accompanied by a steep >60% drop in hourly volume.
theses.non_obvious_interpretation: When price retracement is shallow (<50% of the impulse) while volume decay is steep (>60%), the market structure remains structurally bullish despite appearing weak on short timeframes.
theses.mechanism_causal_chain: Strong spot buying sweeps available supply -> profit-taking causes price dip -> low volume on pullback proves lack of market selling interest -> shallow retracement preserves buyer structure.
theses.contradiction_or_risk: External macro shocks or BTC market dumps can invalidate technical supply/demand mechanics regardless of local structure.
theses.confirmation_condition: Holding above $0.4812 followed by a 1H close above $0.5200. Invalidation on a hourly close below $0.4704.
theses.why_reader_cares: Provides a practical, repeatable rule-of-thumb to evaluate altcoin momentum surges objectively without falling for emotional market noise.
